data.name: Avni
data.gender_notes: Avni is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Avni is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Avni' which means 'Goddess Parvati'. In Hindu mythology, Parvati is the consort of Lord Shiva and is considered the goddess of love, beauty, and fertility. Avni is believed to symbolize grace, beauty, and prosperity. The name Avni carries the meaning “Grace, beauty, prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Avni usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, beauty, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine grace and beauty of Parvati, the consort of Lord Shiva.
data.etymology: Avni belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace, beauty, prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avni total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
